messages:
incident-bot: ALERT — elevated 5xx rate detected for /v1/generate in eu-west during rollout. 5xx rate 12% over 5m (threshold 3%). Canary group: eu-canary-2.
Mira Patel: paging on-call immediately — eu oncall is Olivia, pinging @Olivia Chen.
Olivia Chen: on it. I'm seeing errors in the canary nodes: OOM-ish matrix: 'failed to allocate kv_cache', repeated. Logs attached.
Devon Li: this started right after the blue->green weight flip at 12:04 UTC. We pushed the new runtime with quantized kernels to eu-green pool.
Sam Ortiz: canary traffic was supposed to be 10% but the geo-weight scripts did a split 60/40 for eu for a few minutes — that could explain capacity pressure.
Anya Koval: confirming — augmentation in the rollout script: we had a drifted config. It applied regional weights twice. Investigating the operator who triggered the deploy.
Kevin Zhou: immediate mitigation plan: 1) pause rollout (region-rollout-eu flag) 2) scale up green nodes by +2 gpus temporarily 3) if errors persist, rollback green to previous image.
Mira Patel: do the kill-switch first — flip feature flag so no more traffic to green. How quickly can we flip?
Olivia Chen: flipping `feature:region-rollout-eu` to `off` now.
incident-bot: ACTION — feature flag region-rollout-eu toggled OFF by Olivia Chen at 12:09 UTC. Routing engine will respect new policy within TTL=30s.
Sam Ortiz: seeing immediate drop in 5xx from canary nodes. Global 5xx decreased to 4% in last 2m. Good signal.
Devon Li: logs show the green variant still returning `kv_cache` allocation errors for in-flight sessions; but traffic is declining. Need to ensure no lingering backpressure on upstream LB.
Anya Koval: rolling back the deployment to previous green image as a precaution. Running `kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-green --to-revision=12`
Kevin Zhou: will also add a temporary iptables drop on the unhealthy pods to stop retries from LB, then drain them.
Mira Patel: customer impact assessment — any external user-facing errors? CS reported 3 customer complaints about timeouts for embedders in EU.
Olivia Chen: matching: error traces show 504s to EU customers for requests routed to eu-green AMs. Roughly 0.07% of total requests during window.
Sam Ortiz: opening incident ticket IN-3456. Jira: <https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/IN-3456>.
JiraBot: Issue IN-3456 created by Sam Ortiz — "EU rollout partial fail, feature flag kill-switch and rollback executed".
Devon Li: post-mitigation metric check: token latency back to baseline in eu-west after drain and rollback. No 5xx for last 10m on green or blue.
Anya Koval: root cause preliminary: rollout automation applied regional weight change twice due to retry in orchestration loop, creating higher than expected canary load on green nodes which had a new quantized kernel path with a memory regression.
Kevin Zhou: short-term actions: patch rollout script to guard against duplicated applies, add preflight to validate weight sums. Also pin kernel flag for quantization to opt-in until tested.
Mira Patel: long-term: add automated canary traffic sanity checks (max weight per region), and expand canary capacity checker that simulates peak prefix lengths.
Olivia Chen: handing off to morning oncall. I'll post runbook steps and current state in #eng-oncall.
Mira Patel: good work team. Minor customer outreach drafted, CS to send targeted note to impacted accounts.
Sam Ortiz: postmortem owner assigned: Anya Koval. Target ETA for draft postmortem: 72h.
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED — 5xx rates normalized, kill-switch and rollback applied. Resolved by Olivia Chen at 12:27 UTC.
Mira Patel: ACTION ITEMS:
- Anya: postmortem + timeline (72h)
- Devon: rollout script fix + tests (48h)
- Kevin: kernel opt-out gating + perf test (72h)
- Olivia: update oncall runbook for region rollbacks (24h)
Sam Ortiz: adding note: verify DNS TTLs weren't part of the issue — we saw routing respect flag quick, TTL=30s worked as expected. If anyone wants traces/graphs I'll upload to the incident ticket.
Anya Koval: uploading logs and heap profiles to IN-3456, will include repro steps.
Mira Patel: closing thread here, feel free to follow-up in IN-3456 or #eng-postmortems. :white_check_mark:
